patch.value: Windows consumers gate flakes when a packed npm install exceeds its 180 s spawn timeout

test/duplication-packed.acceptance.ts runs npm install --ignore-scripts for a synthetic packed consumer with a 180 s spawn timeout. On a Windows runner the install exceeded the timeout, so spawnSync returned status null and the exact-status assertion failed, turning the windows-consumers job red for machine load rather than for code. A failed-job rerun on the identical head passed in 2m55. Same class as the busy-machine timing flake already tracked, but a distinct timeout site; consider retrying installs or raising the timeout on windows runners.
